tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: List all the free music-industry tools published by Calientalo Media, with their descriptions and URLs.

tools.name: list_site_routes
tools.description: Return the list of public Calientalo Media routes an agent is allowed to navigate to via navigate_to_page.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a known Calientalo Media page. Use list_site_routes to see available paths. Rejects unknown routes to prevent navigation to invalid or private paths.

path.description: Absolute path starting with "/", e.g. "/blog" or "/about"

tools.name: navigate_to_tool
tools.description: Navigate the browser to one of Calientalo Media's free music-industry tools. Returns the URL that was opened.

tool.description: The slug of the tool to open.
